audience: operations and site reliability teams that watch services logged in Logz.io

useCases.title: Search logs for errors
useCases.text: Search log messages with a Lucene query inside a time range, and page through the hits. Use the log types to narrow the search.

useCases.title: Review alerts that fired
useCases.text: List the triggered alerts by severity or name, then open the alert rule to read its query and conditions.

useCases.title: Disable a noisy alert rule
useCases.text: Disable an alert rule so it sends no notifications, then list the alerts that stay enabled.

useCases.title: Read insights and the audit trail
useCases.text: List the new error patterns that Logz.io found, and the audit events that show who changed what.

useCases.title: Summarize a dashboard
useCases.text: List the dashboard folders and dashboards, then read one dashboard with its panels and queries.
